findings.finding: Carpet-bag looks like a plain tan leather duffel rather than a mottled-fabric 19th‑century carpet-bag with leather trim.
findings.visible_evidence: Under Ishmael’s right arm is a smooth, solid-colored tan bag with soft rounded shape and no mottled textile pattern or distinct leather trim panels.
findings.repair_prompt: Redesign the bag as a small, old-fashioned carpet-bag: mottled fabric body with worn leather trim and handles, scuffed, hand-carried under his arm. Avoid any modern duffel/backpack cues. No readable text or logos.

findings.finding: Patched boots are not clearly patched.
findings.visible_evidence: Boots appear worn and laced but lack obvious rough toe patches or thin, battered soles.
findings.repair_prompt: Emphasize dark leather ankle boots with visible rough toe patches and thin, scuffed soles; keep them clearly battered, not shiny.

findings.finding: Additional background person visible on the right-side pier/street.
findings.visible_evidence: A small human figure stands near the waterfront buildings under a lamp to the right of Ishmael.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove all other people so only Ishmael is visible; keep the wharf desolate.

findings.finding: Ishmael’s breath in the cold air is not apparent.
findings.visible_evidence: No visible condensation plume near his mouth despite snow and icy conditions.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a subtle, wind-blown breath plume from Ishmael to reinforce the bitter cold.

findings.finding: Bottom-center caption zone is occupied by Ishmael’s torso, hands, and bag, leaving no clean negative space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The lowest central area of the frame shows his dark coat and the carpet-bag overlapping a light fog vignette, with no clear empty snow or sky band.
findings.repair_prompt: Raise the subject higher in the composition and clear a low-contrast snow or fog band across the bottom-center (at least 15% of image height) for the caption.

findings.finding: Patched boots, specified as a visible prop, are not visible in the frame.
findings.visible_evidence: The shot crops at mid-thigh and below, showing no footwear.
findings.repair_prompt: Pull back slightly or tilt down to include Ishmael’s scuffed, patch-toed ankle boots in the foreground without adding shine or newness.

findings.finding: An additional person is visible in the background despite the frame specifying only Ishmael.
findings.visible_evidence: A small human figure stands near the lamppost along the snowy street.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove background pedestrians so that only Ishmael is present; keep buildings, snowbanks, and lamppost intact.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag depicted as a large shoulder duffel rather than a small 19th-century carpet-bag carried under the arm.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael carries a cylindrical, soft bag slung by a long strap over his shoulder; it appears bulkier than a compact carpet-bag.
findings.repair_prompt: Redesign the bag as a small, old-fashioned carpet-bag with mottled fabric and leather trim, no shoulder strap; have Ishmael tuck it under one arm while striding.

findings.finding: Patched boots lack clearly visible toe patches and thin battered soles.
findings.visible_evidence: Boots look worn but show no distinct toe patching; soles are not obviously thin or scuffed at the edges.
findings.repair_prompt: Add rough toe patches and visible sole wear to Ishmael’s dark leather ankle boots; avoid any new or shiny finish.

findings.finding: Ishmael’s coughing is not clearly depicted.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is backing through the doorway, but his mouth is closed and there is no visible cough plume or hand-to-mouth gesture.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a subtle cough cue: a small breath cloud or hand-to-mouth motion with a few ash motes near his face, while keeping him mid-retreat with one hand on the door.

findings.finding: Ash-box reads slightly like a brazier due to visible smoke and absence of a lid.
findings.visible_evidence: The low wooden box at the threshold emits a rising wisp of smoke and has no ajar lid, which can imply burning coals rather than cold ashes.
findings.repair_prompt: Show the ash-box half-filled with fine gray ash and include a thin lid leaning ajar on its rim; reduce or eliminate smoke and add scattered ash dust on the floor.

findings.finding: Boot toe patches on Ishmael are not distinctly visible.
findings.visible_evidence: His ankle boots appear worn but lack clear rough toe patches specified for continuity.
findings.repair_prompt: Add obvious rough toe patches and thin, scuffed soles on Ishmael’s boots while keeping their dark, battered look.

findings.finding: Patched boots are not visible despite being a called-out visible prop.
findings.visible_evidence: The framing crops Ishmael above the knees; no boots are shown.
findings.repair_prompt: Widen or lower the framing to include Ishmael’s feet and depict dark, battered ankle boots with visible toe patches and thin soles.

findings.finding: Unspecified background people are present on the dock.
findings.visible_evidence: Two small human figures are visible walking near the lamplights along the waterfront.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove distant pedestrians or reduce them to non-figurative silhouettes/posts so that only Ishmael is visibly present.

findings.finding: Top-center caption zone is partially occupied by the hanging sign and chain, reducing clean negative space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The wooden signboard and its iron hangers extend into the upper-center area against the sky.
findings.repair_prompt: Shift the sign slightly left or crop/recompose so the top-center sky area remains clean and evenly toned for caption placement.
